title: v0.8: scans and wormholes work in multiplayer
text: Scans now last into the next turn, and ships travel through connected wormholes. Update to v0.8.0 from the launcher so your scans work: an older launcher still plays, but its scans are undone. Galaxy One starts Saturday 28 November at noon Mountain time (19:00 UTC), and everyone who joins before then starts on the same turn.
